name: Obed
overview: Obed is a male figure noted in Scripture as one of the mighty men in King David's armies, highlighting his role as a valiant warrior. While his tribal affiliation is not specified, his inclusion among David's elite fighters underscores his importance in the military strength of Israel during David's reign. There are no additional notes recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Obed means 'servant' or 'worshiper' in Hebrew, reflecting a designation of service or devotion. This proper name, as found in 1 Chronicles 11:47, was not given directly by God but carries a meaningful connotation consistent with a faithful servant.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for Obed beyond his identification as one of David's mighty men. No additional relational details are provided in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Obed's significance lies in his status as one of the mighty men who formed the core of King David's military forces. This distinction places him among the loyal and courageous warriors who supported David's kingship and contributed to the establishment and defense of Israel's kingdom. His mention affirms the valor and dedication of those who served under David.
